insight.title: The Constant Performance
insight.subtitle: This subtle shift in behavior profoundly alters how we experience our own lives.
insight.notificationHook: The internet made you a performer.

sections.text: That subtle urge to frame a moment, not just live it, but to capture it perfectly for the feed? It's the internet's performance art, and we're all cast members.
It's not always vanity. Our brains are hardwired for social reward, and platforms have optimized this. We subconsciously curate life for digital validation: likes, shares, comments.
This blurs the line between genuine experience and curated performance. The purest joy of being truly present, unobserved, becomes a scarce and almost rebellious act.
Sometimes, the best content is never posted.
